_meta.description: Generic trigger phrase library for query generation. Slot-level only — no card IDs. {name} is a compose-time placeholder filled from card metadata, not a hardcoded card reference.
_meta.composition_rule: Pick one trigger phrase + one effect phrase + one target phrase per binding. Never put effect text inside trigger phrases.
_meta.when_vs_whenever: For retrieval training, When and Whenever belong to the same slot family unless the query explicitly asks about repeatability.
_meta.card_mapping: Per-card trigger bindings live in parsed_cards.jsonl (parser output), not in this library.
_meta.name_placeholder: {name} = card display name at query compose time. Phrases with uses_name:true require substitution; uses_name:false phrases stay generic for mechanic-level retrieval.
_meta.candidate_render_note: candidate_render is for synthetic card text only. Existing phrases remain the query-generation phrase pool. Candidate templates must be complete Oracle-like trigger prefixes and must not contain effect, target, duration, or query shorthand wording.

DEFEND.note: Pool may use 'defends'; MTG Oracle often uses 'blocks'. Same slot.

DEALS_DAMAGE.label: Deals Damage (Outgoing)

END_STEP.label: Next End Step
END_STEP.subject: delayed_effect
END_STEP.note: Leading timing ('At the beginning of the next end step') or trailing delayed clause on spells.

CONSTELLATION.label: Constellation
CONSTELLATION.subject: controller
CONSTELLATION.note: Includes standard 'another enchantment enters' and self-ETB constellation variants.

LAND_ENTERS.label: Land Enters Battlefield
LAND_ENTERS.subject: this_land
LAND_ENTERS.note: Separate from creature ETB. This pool often bundles land entry with mana in one sentence.

LAND_MANA.label: Land Mana Production
LAND_MANA.subject: this_land
LAND_MANA.note: Mana ability only. Do not mix entry tapped/untapped state here.

LAND_ACTIVATED.label: Land Activated Ability
LAND_ACTIVATED.subject: this_land
LAND_ACTIVATED.note: Not a triggered ability. Kept here for retrieval query phrases.
